Bringing old gold?

We value it while you wait, and show you the scale.

  • Cleaning and polishing of pieces bought here is free, any time.
  • Valuation for insurance or resale is available by appointment.
  • We will tell you honestly when a repair is worth doing, and when it is not.

Accessibility

Tell us what you need and we will arrange it before you arrive.

  • Lift access and step-free entry from the arcade side.
  • Seating at the counter, and a private room for longer appointments.
  • Urdu, Punjabi and English spoken. Sign interpretation on request.
